_doc: DIE-S81-51/RF-D cap_rt RF2 (plan of record, outline / pins unchanged)

ot_s81sl_cap_rt.why: S81-RF1 RE-FORM (DIE-S81-51/RF-B 11-03): hard child of ot_s81sl_capc5r, two strikes (cap_rt LS TT -94, caprt ECO TT -122 / pair skew 151). SRAM on the S edge, 3 clock entries <= 5k sinks (declared multi-root, same root ck_rt), group-local key compare, out-face lockup latch. Defines in spec.json.
ot_s81sl_cap_rt._rfd: DIE-S81-51/RF-D 11-03 S81-044 RE-FORM RF2 (RF1 = 2): h-column pre-select of the ev / es lookups in the slot groups + registered decision selects (sb / do_rel copies, per-side group one-hots); 0 edges moved (lockstep vs RF1 = 1). Outline / pins / SRAM site / clock entries = rf1.

ot_s81sl_capc5r.why_multi_root: S81-CORE-LAT-R20 10-27 (COORD S81-CORES-R1 ruling 2): DECLARED multi-root core (spec clock_entry_domains, same_pll_fixed_phase 1:1): one clock / entry per root pin, each at the 12.3 budget, inter-root paths timed as related pairs
